name: Assassination Plot
summary: In Thousand Needles, centaur move against Kanati Greycloud at Whitereach Post. Intercepted orders reveal their plan to attack the tauren hunter.

sections.title: A Hunter in Hostile Lands
sections.body: Kanati Greycloud is a tauren hunter camped at Whitereach Post in contested Thousand Needles. The small post lies southwest of the Great Lift, amid warring centaur clans and dangerous wildlife. The local centaur see his camp as a bold intrusion into their territory. They mean to kill Greycloud and discourage further Horde expansion through the canyon.

sections.title: The Intercepted Orders
sections.body: Intercepted centaur orders name Kanati Greycloud as their target. The decree condemns his boldness and orders a strike force to converge on Whitereach Post, destroy the camp, and kill anyone who might follow him. With the orders in hand, you can warn Kanati in time to prepare for the raiders' attack.

faq.answer: Local centaur are planning a coordinated ambush against Kanati Greycloud, the tauren hunter camped at Whitereach Post in Thousand Needles. They want him dead to keep the Horde from gaining a foothold in the canyon.
Kanati Greycloud is a tauren hunter camped at Whitereach Post, southwest of the Great Lift in Thousand Needles. His camp lies near centaur territory, making him a target.

faq.q: Why do the centaur want to kill Kanati?
faq.answer: The centaur see Kanati's camp at Whitereach Post as an intolerable intrusion into Thousand Needles. They plan to kill him, destroy the camp, and deter future Horde scouts from settling in the region.
Whitereach Post is a small tauren camp on the canyon floor in Thousand Needles, southwest of the Great Lift.

faq.q: Can Alliance players complete this quest?
faq.answer: Alliance travelers can recover the Assassination Note, but they cannot deliver the warning to Kanati Greycloud. He is a Horde tauren, so only the Horde can bring it to him.

faq.q: What happens after Kanati is warned?
faq.answer: When Kanati receives the warning, he refuses to flee and prepares to fight off the attackers. The defense of Whitereach Post begins when the centaur war band arrives.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know centaur hatred runs deep in tauren memory. Defending Kanati Greycloud at Whitereach Post continues the struggle to protect Kalimdor's plains and canyons from centaur aggression.
As a member of the Horde, you can see Whitereach Post as a small outpost southwest of the Great Lift. Kanati's survival matters to the Horde's watch over Thousand Needles.
